name: smoke-detector
description: A round smoke detector with three curved vents and a central test button.
useCase: Smoke detector equipment, sensor placement or home safety devices.
misuse: Pair alarm states with a clear text label; this icon identifies the device.

16.reason: Three complete vent arcs surround a centered, native-visible test button.

24.reason: Longer vent arcs and a larger test button keep every opening clear.
